items.briefing:
New research from OneTrust highlights that many Australian organisations are adopting AI tools faster than they're putting proper governance and oversight in place — a growing risk as staff increasingly use AI in their daily work. Separately, a reminder that AI chat tools like ChatGPT may have human reviewers reading your conversations, so avoid sharing sensitive student or organisational information through these platforms.

A critical security flaw in GitLab could expose software supply chains, so if your organisation uses GitLab, check that it's fully updated. **Practical tip:** Before using any AI tool for work, check whether your organisation has an approved AI policy — and if unsure, ask your manager before sharing any work-related information.
